retained_semantic_objects.summary: A separately trusted parent observer can reject evaluator-input tampering even when candidate-controlled CI is green, without executing candidate code.
Different papers/routes/agents are not independent evidence when they share datasets, samples, code, upstream sources or derivation ancestry; saturation independence needs lineage coordinates.

Pull-request API source head and the synthesized merge revision actually executed by checkout can differ; exact evaluation authority must bind source head, base, integration tree/revision and executed subject separately.

reinforced_existing_fibers.finding: Goal-oriented design should target declared prediction/decision QoIs, while robust/generalized/maximin design warns against brittle information gain under misspecification.
Privileged observers should execute trusted code only and treat candidate content as passive data under least privilege.

source_routes: official GitHub Actions security and event documentation
GitHub Security Lab workflow security guidance
goal-oriented and robust Bayesian experimental design

saturation.reason: Three non-duplicate semantic objects were retained and the integration-subject identity residual reopened evaluator work. Goal-robust information gain was reinforcement of an already-open fiber rather than double-counted as new.

scope_limits: Parent evaluator v1 proves protected-input integrity, not full behavioral correctness.
workflow_run is itself a privileged context; candidate content must remain passive and least-privileged.
The observer currently inspects source head while PR test checkout executed a synthesized merge commit; META_N024 is open.
Evidence-lineage-aware saturation was not activated without an executable frozen benchmark.
Goal-robust information-gain acquisition was not activated without RAKL-specific known-answer worlds.

next_ai.positive: Freeze executable META_N024 worlds first; bind source head, base revision, integration tree/revision and actual executed subject using trusted/external observations. Then stage the smallest challenger and require the parent observer to detect planted subject mismatches.
next_ai.null: If all subject-identity worlds reconcile, preserve the null and move to META_N023 evidence-lineage independence without inventing a defect.
next_ai.refuted: If parent subject binding itself can be bypassed or requires executing candidate code, preserve the counterexample, keep current observer only as a scoped integrity check and search a different trusted-attestation architecture.
next_ai.partial_id: If GitHub exposes some but not all executed-subject coordinates, report partial identification and avoid claiming exact-SHA authority.
next_ai.blocked: If trusted platform observations cannot expose the executed revision, record CANNOT_CHECK rather than accepting candidate-produced metadata as authoritative.
next_ai.transport: On GitHub/API transport failure, do not change promotion/evaluator semantics; preserve candidate/ref state and retry the same frozen experiment in a later run.
